quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (filed 08-14-2026): foundry is reported inside the DS division (H1 2026 DS revenue KRW 209,231,714M, +294.7% YoY; DS operating profit KRW 142,859,293M; foundry P&L not broken out). Market view in the filing: foundry-market growth in Q2 2026 was driven by full-scale mass production of 2nm mobile products and continued migration of premium AI/HPC products to leading-edge nodes; in H2 2026 leading-edge growth continues on strong AI/HPC demand and Chinese domestic-sourcing demand persists; mainstream nodes are expected to grow more slowly but benefit from pricing as some competitors cut capacity. Samsung's own outlook: leading-edge revenue growth expected on solid demand, led by the 2nm 2nd-generation mobile product entering mass production in H2 2026 and the full ramp of 4nm AI/HPC products; on 2nm the company is EXPANDING ORDERS FROM LARGE DATA-CENTER CUSTOMERS to strengthen its mid-to-long-term growth engine; mainstream nodes are securing specialty process technologies and diversifying customer orders for higher-value products, profitability improvement and long node lifetimes. Strategy statement: node- and application-specific plans to strengthen technology/development, manufacturing and business competitiveness, and end-to-end development/order/production/supply capability. Foundry is described as a market where ~5 large-capacity players hold most of the market after many IDMs went fabless.
quarterly_data.figure: Foundry inside DS (H1 DS rev KRW 209.2T, +295% YoY); 2nm 2nd-gen mobile mass production H2 2026; 4nm AI/HPC ramp; expanding 2nm orders from large data-center customers

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), disclosed foundry order book (section II.4 and XI.1): the only itemised foundry order is the Tesla, Inc. semiconductor contract-manufacturing (foundry) supply contract - DS division Foundry business, signed 07-26-2025, contract end date 12-31-2033, total order value USD 16,544M; the filing notes the amount and end date may change with customer demand and business progress, and omits quantities, amounts delivered to date and remaining backlog as trade secrets. Beyond Tesla, the 2nm node is winning expanded orders from large data-center customers, and 4nm HPC-dedicated production (4th-generation 4nm process, mass production since 11-2024, supporting 2.5D/3D advanced packaging) is ramping for AI/HPC customers; the HBM4 base die is produced on Samsung's 4nm logic process for the memory business (logic-memory-foundry-packaging 'one-stop solution'). Separate-entity note: no other long-term supply contracts material to the financial statements existed at 06-30-2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Tesla foundry contract USD 16,544M (signed 07-26-2025, runs to 12-31-2033); 2nm data-center customer orders expanding; backlog not disclosed

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), capacity and capex: DS division facility investment KRW 25,603.0B in H1 2026 (group total KRW 27,986.4B) centred on advanced-process expansion/conversion and infrastructure; the filing states system semiconductors are 'investing to secure ADVANCED-NODE CAPA'. The Management Committee approved 'Foundry investment' resolutions on 05-15-2026 and 05-28-2026 (alongside seven memory-investment resolutions Feb-May 2026 and a GPU investment on 04-14-2026); independent directors visited the new HPC sites at the Giheung and Hwaseong campuses on 10-30-2025 for a Foundry business review. US: Samsung Austin Semiconductor LLC (SAS, semiconductor production, Austin/Taylor Texas) had total assets KRW 36,260,678M and liabilities KRW 24,144,525M at 06-30-2026 (up from KRW 29,787,509M / 18,505,380M at year-end), H1 revenue KRW 1,864,817M and a net loss of KRW 5,641M; a USD 6,435,000K parent guarantee (Samsung Electronics America to the US Government, from 12-20-2024, open-ended) backs SAS's obligation to repay CHIPS Act subsidies if the subsidy agreement is not fulfilled, and SAS has a USD 275,000K guarantee to Epcor (utility). Government grants received KRW 1,592,914M in H1 2026 (consolidated cash flow). A new production subsidiary, Samsung Vietnam Semiconductor (SVS), was established 03-2026 in Thai Nguyen. DS raw materials: wafers KRW 1,150.0B in H1 from Siltronic and SK Siltron (price -10% YoY), chemicals KRW 1,697.5B from Soulbrain and Dongwoo Fine-Chem. Consolidated purchase commitments for PP&E/intangibles not yet incurred KRW 30,543,192M.
quarterly_data.figure: DS capex KRW 25.6T in H1 2026; two Foundry investment resolutions (05-15-2026, 05-28-2026); SAS (Austin/Taylor) assets KRW 36.3T, H1 rev KRW 1.86T; USD 6.435B CHIPS-subsidy guarantee

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (08-14-2026), process roadmap and product milestones (R&D detail table): 4nm 4th-generation HPC-dedicated process in mass production since 11-2024 (high-speed transistors, improved BEOL for lower RC delay, 2.5D/3D advanced-packaging support); 3nm 2nd-generation GAA in mass production since 03-2025 (vs 5nm: 35% smaller area, 40%+ lower power, up to 30% faster; flagship 5G mobile plus AI/HPC); 2nm 1st-generation GAA (mobile-optimised) in mass production since 09-2025 (vs 3nm 2nd gen: +5% performance, +8% power efficiency, -5% area, DTCO); 2nm 2nd-generation mobile product mass production scheduled for H2 2026 and 4nm AI/HPC product mass production in full ramp. Internal anchor products: Exynos 2600 - the industry's first mobile AP on a 2nm GAA process (CPU +39%, GPU ray tracing +50%, NPU AI +113% vs Exynos 2500, first mobile SoC with a heat-path block); Exynos 2500 on 3nm GAA with FOWLP packaging; Exynos W1000 wearable SoC on 3nm with FO-PLP/SiP/ePoP packaging; Exynos 1480 on 4nm; the HBM4 base die (4nm) and the PCIe 6.0 SSD PM1763 controller (4nm) are also produced on Samsung logic nodes. System LSI is pursuing new Custom SoC business for Agentic AI and the SoC business entered the Galaxy Flip 8. The company's 2026 history highlights list the world-first HBM4E 12-high sample shipment and world-first HBM4 mass-production shipment (both foundry-enabled via the 4nm base die). Governance: the DS division's incoming board member Kim Yong-kwan (appointed 03-18-2026) is charged with external cooperation and investor communication for the expanding AI/robot market; independent-director sessions on 01-28-2026 covered a semiconductor technology-leak follow-up and on 06-23-2026 next-generation strategic products and new-business progress.
quarterly_data.figure: 2nm GAA 1st gen in MP since 09-2025 (Exynos 2600 first 2nm mobile AP); 2nm 2nd gen H2 2026; 3nm 2nd gen GAA since 03-2025; 4nm HPC 4th gen since 11-2024; HBM4 base die on 4nm
